title: Fix worldofgeese issues #1311-#1314
intent: Implement the decision-free, additive native fixes for #1311, #1312, #1313, and #1314 in one PR: remove unrelated database coupling from specs.refresh, preserve legacy trajectory behavior while archiving per-run evidence, centralize event writes and add supported integrity diagnostics, and normalize persisted local paths.
stop_conditions: Stop for human review if a proposed compatibility fix requires changing existing request/response schemas, silently changing validation or publication authority, bypassing the Dactyl storage boundary, or recovering a corrupted database without a supported Dactyl API.
deferred_questions: Choose the canonical multi-run trajectory contract: sidecar archive with explicit selection, a schema-v2 multi-run map, or per-run canonical artifacts with an index.
Choose whether Decapod should provide automatic dump-and-reload SQLite repair, including backup/restore and cross-process coordination semantics, through the Dactyl boundary.
